summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K attaching a monthly return of equity issuer for June 2026, submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The filing details authorized and issued share capital for Class A and Class B ordinary shares, with no changes in share count or treasury shares during the month. It also provides a public float sufficiency confirmation. This is a routine periodic regulatory filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves to furnish the Hong Kong monthly return to US markets.
